about: PadelRecs catalog expansion (owner chose 'mid & top models', 2026-10-19): 2025–2027 performance models of the brands already on the site, colour variants merged, beginner/budget and junior models left out, rackets already on the site left out. Model year = the year in the shop's product name. Shape, weight and balance only where the linked page states them plainly (Spanish shop pages translated: diamante=Diamond, redonda=Round, lágrima=Teardrop, híbrida=Hybrid); everything else blank rather than guessed. Brand ids are the live site's existing ids. Added on 2026-10-21 from reviews held as missing products: values from the linked page only, blank where it gives none. Wilson Bela LS V3's year is from Padel Kiwi's listing (in its catalogue since June 2025); shape from Tennis Warehouse.
